rawPayload.Product_Description_Legacy: The AXOR Edge collection explores extreme refinement, inspired by the French tradition of Arts Décoratifs. Each solid brass faucet body is cut, milled, and polished to micron precision using state-of-the-art diamond-tipped tooling from the aerospace industry. This process gives the Polished Gold Optic finish an unparalleled, jewel-like smoothness and reflective brilliance.

product.description:
Unique and differentiating. AXOR Edge faucets transcend boundaries: The cube as a formative design element. High-gloss surfaces that maximize the distinctiveness of the collection. No matter which variant, an AXOR Edge faucet is that something extra for people with discerning taste.

Axor 46020 Features:

  • Saves water, energy and money: The flow rate is automatically restricted to max. 1.2 GPM, even when the water pressure varies (EcoRight)
  • Particularly durable: equipped with high-quality, smooth-running ceramic mixing system from AXOR
  • Fuller, lighter, softer droplets: This faucet enriches the water with air for a nicer feeling (AirPower)
  • More freedom of movement: the distance between the spout and the sink provides space for comfortable use (ComfortZone)
  • Stronger handle: The boltic lever lock allows for repeated use of your faucet without getting loose after time
  • Easy to install: The faucet is attached to the water connections via flexible connection hoses (3/8-inch)
  • Spray type: This faucet features an aerated spray which causes less splashing than traditional faucets
  • Easy-care and long-lasting chrome finish: The shiny chrome finish boasts a lasting shine
  • Installation notes: Hansgrohe recommends a licensed plumber install this product
  • Limited lifetime consumer warranty: Consumer purchases of AXOR products from authorized sellers are covered by a limited lifetime manufacturer warranty applicable to the original purchaser

Axor 46020 Specifications:

  • Height: 8-11/16" (deck to top of faucet)
  • Spout Height: 7-13/16" (deck to spout outlet)
  • Spout Reach: 6-7/8" (faucet base to spout outlet)
  • Flow Rate: 1.2 gallons-per-minute
  • Faucet Hole Size: 1-1/4"
  • Faucet Holes: 1 (minimum number of holes required for installation)
